verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack shows a FIPS 140-validated or Common Criteria-certified Solo 2 model, which is the core of this story. The only durability evidence is a single community comment calling it 'water resistant'. That is not vendor-documented water or crush resistance and does not address certification, so no credit is given.

support.subject: As an IT admin, certified models exist for regulated environments — FIPS 140 validated or Common Criteria certified — with documented durability (water/crush resistance)
